parameters.filterByFormula: ={{ (()=>{const b=$('Webhook').first().json.body,d=b.data||{};const vals=[b.event?.workspace_id,d.campaign?.id,d.lead?.id];if(vals.some(v=>!/^\d+$/.test(String(v??''))))throw Error('Bounce conversation identity incomplete');const mailbox=String(d.sender_email?.email||'').trim().toLowerCase();if(!/^[a-z0-9.!#$%&*+/?^_`{|}~=-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}$/i.test(mailbox))throw Error('Bounce sender mailbox invalid');return "AND({Workspace ID (Bison)}='"+vals[0]+"',{campaign_id}='"+vals[1]+"',{lead_id}="+vals[2]+",LOWER({Inbox Email})='"+mailbox.replace(/'/g,"\'")+"')";})() }}
